name: The Ritz Carlton Kapalua
positioning: Resort in Kapalua on Maui with direct access to D.T. Fleming Beach, marketed officially as The Ritz-Carlton Maui, Kapalua
best_for: Travelers who want beach access and a resort with wine and food events
Guests interested in Hawaiian history and culture

facts.text: D.T. Fleming Beach is steps from the resort and offers lifeguards, picnic areas and a gentle shore break.
The resort maintains the Honokahua Preservation Site, a recognized sacred site (wahi pana) adjacent to the resort.
The resort has six restaurants and bars.
Banyan Tree hosts a Chef's Table every Friday, shared at a community table for up to 10 guests.
The Kapalua Wine & Food Festival is held every June as a weekend of exhibitions, wine tastings and gala events.
The spa has 15 treatment rooms, over half of which open onto private outdoor shower gardens, and two private outdoor couples' hale (cabanas).
Residential suites have kitchens and up to two bedrooms.
The resort has on-property pickleball and tennis courts, available to hotel guests first-come, first-served.
The property has a multi-tiered pool.
More than 70 resort experiences are offered each week.

highlights.text: During construction in 1987, an ancient burial site of Native Hawaiians was uncovered, and the project was redesigned with the hotel shifted inland to preserve the sacred site.
Ground-floor suites offer added amenities like firepits and direct lawn access.
The Ambassadors of the Environment program, run with Jean-Michel Cousteau's Ocean Futures Society, introduces guests to the local culture and environment.
Tales of the Kapa Moe Lu'au is held in the open-air Aloha Garden Pavilion and includes Hawaiian chanting and hula, an aerial performance and a fire knife dance.
Club access includes The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge at the Anuenue Room, with a private lounge, dedicated concierge, open bar and a buffet that refreshes five times a day.

considerations.text: On-site valet parking costs $65.00 per day.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
Minors under 18 may not receive body treatments, massages or facials at the spa.
